USER GUIDE
1. WHAT IS THIS MANIPULATIVE?
EPICYCLIC 12:1 GEARS & MODULO ARITHMETIC
Time is continuous rotational motion and modular arithmetic.The StackCalc Classroom Clock features an internal compound gearset: 12:1 Exact Planetary Reduction RatioWhen the minute hand completes 1 full revolution (360°),the planetary sun-and-planet gears advance the hour hand by 30°!
CALIBRATED 60-MINUTE / 12-HOUR DATUM {xml_escape(dl)}\n{xml_escape(dl)}\n{xml_escape(dl)}\n{xml_escape(dl)}\n
CLOCK STAND LID & MODULAR WEDGE BAYS
The 7U storage lid features an angled desktop easel stand andcolor-coded radial slots to store 15-min, 30-min, and 5-min wedges.Drop wedges into the dial to measure elapsed time kinesthetically!
PLANETARY GEARS: 12:1 RATIO AT 3:30 (105°)
12 3 6 9
12:1 EPICYCLIC GEARS 360° min → 30° hour At 3:30: Hour hand = 105° 15-Min Quadrant Wedge: 90° arc = 1/4 of an hour Modulo 12 & Modulo 60
2. KIT PARTS INVENTORY (18 PIECES)
COMPONENT QTY SPEC / DIMENSION PALETTE COLOR
Geared Clock Frame 1x 105.0 mm Dial (12h/60m) Slate Gray
12:1 Epicyclic Gear 1x Internal Sun-Planet Mesh Gold / Blue
15-Min Wedges 4x 90° Quadrant (1/4 Hour) Sky Blue
30-Min Wedges 2x 180° Semicircle (1/2 Hour) Royal Purple
5-Min Wedges 8x 30° Hour Sector (1/12th) Emerald Green
Display Stand Lid 1x Clock Stand & Wedge Bay Matte Charcoal
3x1 Storage Bin 1x 49.0 mm Height (7U) Matte Charcoal

3. WHY KEEP THIS REFERENCE CARD?
✓ NO LOST PIECE LEFT BEHIND
Classroom manipulatives get lost. Never abandon an incomplete set! Every individual math component is permanently stocked for single replacements.
Scan back QR or visit stackcalc.io/parts Order individual replacement pieces anytime
✓ 10-SECOND SELF-CHECKING PACK-UP
Pack-up is a built-in math game! Seat the clock frame into itsrecessed bottom cradle. Drop the 14 colored wedges into theirlabeled radial lid bays. Any missing wedge leaves an empty bay.Easel lid latches firmly for silent, rattle-free carry.
✓ HANDS-ON TUTORIAL ON REVERSE
Flip this card over for a complete step-by-step hands-on lesson with concrete numbers, stage arrangements, calculator cross-references, and core mathematical principle breakthrough! Keep this card stored inside the box lid!
